originalDescriptionVerbatim: From lane B's syzygy-bpyt.65 plan (2026-10-28): scripts/clean_build.mjs does not refuse a tsconfig whose ts.getParsedCommandLineOfConfigFile parse carries recoverable errors (parsed.errors, e.g. a missing extends target). Today such a tree reaches tsc -b and fails there, after the dists are removed. Refuse it inside visit, before anything is removed, with a message naming the file and the first error. Refuses nothing tsc -b accepts (it only moves the refusal before removal), so check that claim with a base-vs-head refusal matrix; owner notice on syzygy-bpyt.10 only if the matrix shows a newly refused tree. After syzygy-bpyt.65.
